summary: S-CAISSE (the POS box) decomposed read-only audit — one agent per functionality, worktree-pinned, adversarial. Scores technical/logic/vision, maps to 19-P1, identifies live E2E surfaces.

NEEDS_FIX: order-taking + POS wizard composition (item-add → cart → quote flow)
Manual discount + reason persistence across page reload

Park/Recall Order — backend service correctly builds warnings for unavailable variations and item dropouts; frontend silently ignores them and shows unconditional success toast. Cashier never discovers the restored cart differs from what was parked.
Payment/Encaissement (cash/TR/card/split + counter-collect) for FoodKing V1 POS single-branch Le Cayenne
Cash drawer session + reconciliation (open/close/reconcile lifecycle with NF525 variance gate and audit trail binding)

Refund pre-Z and post-Z — single endpoint (PosOrderController::refundWithCounterEntry) branches on SealedOrderGuard::isSealed() to route pre-Z orders to OrderService::changeStatus(RETURNED) and post-Z orders to RefundWithCounterEntryService. Expected: both paths dispatch RefundCreated to trigger identical cascades (stock release, availability release, loyalty clawback, payment-status broadcast). Actual: only post-Z path dispatches RefundCreated; pre-Z path skips it entirely (or conditionally if no prior payment TX exists), leaving stock/availability/loyalty side-effects incomplete.

Receipt + NF525 operator identity: ReceiptDataService resolves the operator_name field (printed on every POS receipt header) from order->user->name (the CUSTOMER), ignoring order->creator_id (the CASHIER), breaking NF525 conformance on operator attribution.
POS offline replay + idempotency: offline CASH order enqueueing, queue replay with X-Idempotency-Key, no-sale drawer audit POST
RED-box-dispute: Split-payment + Refund-mirror + Z-bucketing cross-functional defect

blockingFindings.from: Refund pre-Z and post-Z — single endpoint (PosOrderController::refundWithCounterEntry) branches on SealedOrderGuard::isSealed() to route pre-Z orders to OrderService::changeStatus(RETURNED) and post-Z orders to RefundWithCounterEntryService. Expected: both paths dispatch RefundCreated to trigger identical cascades (stock release, availability release, loyalty clawback, payment-status broadcast). Actual: only post-Z path dispatches RefundCreated; pre-Z path skips it entirely (or conditionally if no prior payment TX exists), leaving stock/availability/loyalty side-effects incomplete.
blockingFindings.desc: Pre-Z refund (OrderService::changeStatus RETURNED) never dispatches RefundCreated event, breaking the cascade (stock release, availability release, loyalty clawback, payment-status broadcast). Post-Z path (RefundWithCounterEntryService line 415) correctly dispatches RefundCreated::dispatch($parent). Pre-Z path only calls PaymentService::cashBack() when $locked->transaction exists, and even then RefundCreated dispatch inside PaymentService::cashBack() can be skipped if no prior payment transaction exists (line 132-133 early-return). When cashBack() is not called, RefundCreated is NEVER dispatched. RefundCreated import missing from OrderService (line 21-46 shows OrderCanceled import but no RefundCreated import).
blockingFindings.file_line: app/Services/OrderService.php:2196-2203 (cashBack conditional block, NO RefundCreated dispatch) vs app/Services/Order/RefundWithCounterEntryService.php:415 (RefundCreated::dispatch($parent) present)
blockingFindings.repro: Create a pre-Z order with status=DELIVERED and no prior payment Transaction (or with pos_payment_method=CASH paid at counter). Call changeStatus(RETURNED) via PosOrderController::refundWithCounterEntry endpoint. Observe: status flips to RETURNED, cashBack Transaction row created IF prior payment exists, order.returned audit row appended. BUT stock-released_qty counter is NOT incremented (stock remains reserved), availability counter is NOT incremented, loyalty points are NOT clawed back (only refundPoints() is called directly at line 2203, missing the RefundCreated cascade), payment_status broadcast (PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedOnRefundCreated listener) does NOT run. Post-Z mirror refund via same endpoint exhibits full cascade.

Expected: both paths dispatch RefundCreated to trigger identical cascades (stock release, availability release, loyalty clawback, payment-status broadcast). Actual: only post-Z path dispatches RefundCreated; pre-Z path skips it entirely (or conditionally if no prior payment TX exists), leaving stock/availability/loyalty side-effects incomplete.
blockingFindings.desc: PaymentService::cashBack() early-returns without dispatching RefundCreated when order has NO prior 'payment'-type Transaction (line 132-133). This means pre-Z refunds of orders without a prior payment TX get NO stock/availability/loyalty cascade at all, even though OrderService::changeStatus calls refundPoints() (line 2203). Affects orders paid via zero-amount or deferred payment channels where no Transaction row was created during initial payment.
blockingFindings.file_line: app/Services/PaymentService.php:132-134 (early-return skips entire DB::transaction block including RefundCreated dispatch at line 187)
blockingFindings.repro: Create a PAID order with status=DELIVERED and NO prior Transaction row (payment_status=PAID set directly). Call changeStatus(RETURNED). PaymentService::cashBack() early-returns at line 132, NO RefundCreated dispatch, stock/availability/loyalty cascade NEVER runs.

blockingFindings.from: RED-box-dispute: Split-payment + Refund-mirror + Z-bucketing cross-functional defect
blockingFindings.desc: Z-report total_by_method completely ignores order_payments payment tranches and attributes entire order TTC to single pos_payment_method field. This mis-buckets ALL split-payment orders and their refund mirrors. applyOrderToTotals (ZReportService:661-668) queries order.pos_payment_method only, never iterates order_payments rows. Result: a CASH+CARD split-tender order shows as 100% CASH (or 100% CARD, depending on which field was last set) in Z-report per-method breakdown, even though backend correctly stored 50/50 split in order_payments. Refund mirrors (created by RefundWithCounterEntryService) correctly duplicate split-payment tranches into mirror's order_payments (line 196-221), but those ALSO get mis-bucketed by applyOrderToTotals since it ignores payment breakdown. Z-report net totals and per-rate TVA net correctly (by accident, since splits are same-order), but per-tender attribution is completely wrong, breaking reconciliation and per-terminal TPE attribution (Z6-P1-WGS).
blockingFindings.repro: 1. Create split-payment order: CASH 50€ + CARD 50€ (pos_payment_method left unset or set to CASH). 2. Verify order_payments has 2 rows: {mode: CASH, amount: 50}, {mode: CARD, amount: 50}. 3. Close Z-report. 4. Inspect Z->total_by_method: shows {CASH: 100} and {CARD: 0}, or vice-versa depending on fallback. Expected: {CASH: 50, CARD: 50}. 5. Create refund for that order (post-Z). 6. Close next Z. 7. Mirror also bucketed wrong: {CASH: -100} instead of {CASH: -50, CARD: -50}.

blockingFindings.from: RED-box-dispute: Split-payment + Refund-mirror + Z-bucketing cross-functional defect
blockingFindings.desc: Refund mirror receipt (from ReceiptDataService::buildForOrderModel) shows CUSTOMER name as operator_name instead of refunding cashier. Mirror order is created with user_id = parent.user_id (customer) at RefundWithCounterEntryService:110, and creator_id is never set. ReceiptDataService line 70 resolves operator_name = optional($order->user)->name, pulling customer name for both parent AND mirror receipts. S16-01 (collecting cashier not recorded on parent) + this defect compound: refund receipt operator attribution is doubly broken — shows the original CUSTOMER instead of the CASHIER who issued the refund.
blockingFindings.repro: 1. Original order created by cashier Alice for customer Bob. 2. Create refund as cashier Charlie. 3. Print refund mirror receipt. 4. Operator field shows 'Bob' (customer), not 'Charlie' (cashier). Audit trail shows Charlie as the refund creator, but receipt attribution is wrong — NF525 non-compliance.

The NF525 standard (French fiscal POS regulation) requires the receipt to identify "caissier ayant clôturé" (the operator who closed the transaction). details.functionality: RED-box-dispute: Split-payment + Refund-mirror + Z-bucketing cross-functional defect

findings.desc: Z-report total_by_method completely ignores order_payments payment tranches and attributes entire order TTC to single pos_payment_method field. This mis-buckets ALL split-payment orders and their refund mirrors. applyOrderToTotals (ZReportService:661-668) queries order.pos_payment_method only, never iterates order_payments rows. Result: a CASH+CARD split-tender order shows as 100% CASH (or 100% CARD, depending on which field was last set) in Z-report per-method breakdown, even though backend correctly stored 50/50 split in order_payments. Refund mirrors (created by RefundWithCounterEntryService) correctly duplicate split-payment tranches into mirror's order_payments (line 196-221), but those ALSO get mis-bucketed by applyOrderToTotals since it ignores payment breakdown. Z-report net totals and per-rate TVA net correctly (by accident, since splits are same-order), but per-tender attribution is completely wrong, breaking reconciliation and per-terminal TPE attribution (Z6-P1-WGS).
findings.repro: 1. Create split-payment order: CASH 50€ + CARD 50€ (pos_payment_method left unset or set to CASH). 2. Verify order_payments has 2 rows: {mode: CASH, amount: 50}, {mode: CARD, amount: 50}. 3. Close Z-report. 4. Inspect Z->total_by_method: shows {CASH: 100} and {CARD: 0}, or vice-versa depending on fallback. Expected: {CASH: 50, CARD: 50}. 5. Create refund for that order (post-Z). 6. Close next Z. 7. Mirror also bucketed wrong: {CASH: -100} instead of {CASH: -50, CARD: -50}.

findings.desc: Refund mirror receipt (from ReceiptDataService::buildForOrderModel) shows CUSTOMER name as operator_name instead of refunding cashier. Mirror order is created with user_id = parent.user_id (customer) at RefundWithCounterEntryService:110, and creator_id is never set. ReceiptDataService line 70 resolves operator_name = optional($order->user)->name, pulling customer name for both parent AND mirror receipts. S16-01 (collecting cashier not recorded on parent) + this defect compound: refund receipt operator attribution is doubly broken — shows the original CUSTOMER instead of the CASHIER who issued the refund.
findings.repro: 1. Original order created by cashier Alice for customer Bob. 2. Create refund as cashier Charlie. 3. Print refund mirror receipt. 4. Operator field shows 'Bob' (customer), not 'Charlie' (cashier). Audit trail shows Charlie as the refund creator, but receipt attribution is wrong — NF525 non-compliance.

findings.desc: Refund mirror never captures discount_reason from parent order (unlike parked orders which also lose it, but that's a separate pre-Z defect). If parent was discounted with reason 'VIP discount', the mirror's audit trail records the refund but never captures which discount was being refunded. Operationally low-impact (cash is correct, mirror total nets correctly) but forensic gap — mirror reason field contains REFUND reason (line 129), not original discount reason.
findings.repro: 1. Create order for €100, apply €10 'VIP discount' reason. Total = €90. 2. Refund via counter-entry (post-Z). 3. Mirror created with total = -€90 (correct), but discount = 0 (asymmetric). 4. Mirror's reason field contains refund reason, not 'VIP discount'. 5. Refund receipt shows €90 refunded but never indicates the €10 discount was part of it.
